notes.title: 8-21 update
notes.content:
-Sound settings are saved and retained the next time you start the app
-Default font can be changed under settings
-Research process shows reagents consumed and total required
-Added jobs start with max workers
-Minor UI adjustments
-Minor bug fixes

notes.title: 7-24 update
notes.content:
-Added access options in game
-Reduced knowledge reset CD from 24 hrs to 2hrs
-Added back button
-Improved auto scroll
-Added craft until to work tab
-Added mouse wheel scroll on work tab
-New jobs now appear at the top of the list instead of bottom
-Added more job slots
-Red lightening regen x2 and cap x2
-Reduced age start red lightening to 5 mins
